purpose: Prepare existing family/productionId/reuse links and visual-size metadata for the cloud guide; no new queue or count selection.

researchGuide.source: cloud researcher guide summarized by parent and relayed through sole Studio operator
researchGuide.sourceKind: relayed message; original guide artifact bytes not provided
researchGuide.lodRatioBasis: per-identity accepted drawable reference, never destructive replacement of preserved master or an automatic choice
researchGuide.numericProvenance: All ranges, ratios, size windows and master2x margin are cloud test proposals; not measured in this project and not numeric recommendations extracted from the linked tool documentation.

approve exact individual image or deliberate small-group composition hash

totalGeometry.quadApproximationNotAdopted: The relay also expressed roughly half as many quads. Do not use triangle/2 as measured quads or a provider target without verified source topology and triangulation. GLB topology and vertex records remain unmeasured.

metricPolicy: Provider/UI face or vertex labels retain their original meaning and source; do not silently reinterpret UI vertices as geometry or attribute records.
Source quads/polygons, actual exported triangles and vertex records are separate measurements. Record tool/version, primitive mode, accessor/index methodology and triangulation outcome.

POSITION accessor rows are stored attribute-vertex records, not necessarily distinct geometric positions. Record referenced indices separately from unused rows; UV/normal seams can duplicate positions.
A distinct-position count needs declared space and exact/tolerance comparison; it is observational only. Do not weld or destroy seams/normals/UVs to report it.
Count unique stored geometry resources separately from instances/draw occurrences and per-identity selections; shared meshes/atlas prevent naive summation.
No fixed vertex-to-triangle or face-to-vertex ratio. Source quads, if retained, do not imply exported GLB quad primitives.

Total provider target is not a per-item target or equal allocation. Relayed category triangle/LOD bands are now recorded as hypotheses; category vertex minima remain null. No actual metric, provider target or minimum is inferred.

Keep immutable joint/source master, extracted child and each drawable LOD as different stages with hashes and comparable counts. Local extraction must not reduce geometry; any change requires explained revision and renewed QA.

Primitive mode and index entry count are explicit. Referenced unique attribute rows differ from index entries; indexCount/3 gives triangles only for valid indexed TRIANGLES, not strips/fans/lines/points.

Simplifier-reported approximate/normalized error, possibly attribute-aware, is not automatically conservative geometricError and cannot set errorVerified=true. Record metric/units/reference, independently establish a conservative bound and pass visual/material QA.
visualSizePolicy: Native28x28 inventory cells and1536x1024 concept canvases are verified presentation metadata, not physical size or close-camera screen coverage. Composition boxes are framing reserves. Physical bounds, camera/FOV/depth/viewport and projected size remain unmeasured.
closeViewQa: Preserve scroll spirals/ribbon/thickness and vial neck/cork/cord/glass/liquid; evaluate close silhouette/material and conservative projected error before any LOD choice. The existing selector provides no category triangle budget.
runtimePolicy: Parser/transport limits remain technical compatibility gates, not artistic minima. Preserve unsupported source data and native fallback; no automatic decimation, source overwrite or install.

reuse.policy: Explicit concept linkage only, not approved geometry reuse. Preserve unique/dynamic/material identities and review family exceptions.

candidates.resourcesPolicy: Keep immutable joint/source master and exact child lineage. Preserve UVs/normals/tangents/materials/textures/atlas/transforms/pivot. Shared resources can be duplicated in self-contained exports; do not claim memory saving.
